1.texto_original: Lihatlah, TUHAN memperlihatkan kepadaku dua keranjang buah ara berdiri di hadapan bait TUHAN. Hal itu terjadi sesudah Nebukadnezar, raja Babel, mengangkut ke dalam pembuangan Yekhonya bin Yoyakim, raja Yehuda, beserta para pemuka Yehuda, tukang dan pandai besi dari Yerusalem dan membawa mereka ke Babel.
1.normal:
Devotional Study of Yeremia 24:1

"Lihatlah, TUHAN memperlihatkan kepadaku dua keranjang buah ara berdiri di hadapan bait TUHAN. Hal itu terjadi sesudah Nebukadnezar, raja Babel, mengangkut ke dalam pembuangan Yekhonya bin Yoyakim, raja Yehuda, beserta para pemuka Yehuda, tukang dan pandai besi dari Yerusalem dan membawa mereka ke Babel."

This verse carries deep theological significance. The original Hebrew/Greek text reveals layers of meaning that illuminate Gods character and purposes. The context within the broader narrative provides essential framework for understanding.

The historical backdrop adds richness to interpretation. Archaeological discoveries continue to confirm and illuminate the cultural setting in which these words were written.

For the modern reader, this verse offers both comfort and challenge. It invites us to trust in Gods sovereign plan while actively living out its principles in daily life.
